subject: Return-to-work: adjusted schedule & coverage plan for Mina Haddad
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, emma@careconnect.tech
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RTW: adjusted schedule request

Hi Jonas —

I want to confirm my plan for returning to work after the surgery. My doctor (see attached OT note) recommends a graduated return at ~60% FTE for the first 6 weeks with no heavy lifting and a seated-only baseline. Occupational therapy will start next week.

Suggested practical schedule: core overlap hours Mon/Wed/Thu 10:00–15:00 (in-office or remote as needed), lighter remote days Tue/Fri focused on documentation and async reviews. I can handle triage for my priority bugs but will need a buddy for on-call/PT triage handoffs for the first month.

I’m looping in Monica to coordinate benefits/payroll and Emma from the occupational health partner for any formal notes. I can sign the flexible schedule agreement if that’s the right path.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Software Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OT_note_Mina_Haddad.pdf (occupational therapy note, stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, emma@careconnect.tech
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RTW: adjusted schedule request

Thanks for the note and the OT summary, Mina — glad to hear the initial prognosis is encouraging.

High-level plan:
- We’ll implement a 0.6 FTE schedule for 6 weeks, starting Mon 9 Nov (your preferred start date).
- Coverage: Dev will take primary on-call rotation for your squad for weeks 1–4; Monica will cover priority stakeholder comms and release sign-offs as needed.
- Weekly 30-min check-in on Mondays to review capacity and symptom progression.
- We’ll use a signed flexible schedule agreement (attached draft) and a DocuSign link for approvals.

Action items for me: draft mutual action plan + sign-off email to Monica and HR, book recurring check-ins, and schedule a 1:1 with you to confirm the exact start/stop times.

I attached a draft flex schedule agreement for review (flex_schedule_agreement.docx). If occupational health confirms the restrictions, we’ll finalize and HR will process pay/proration.

Onward —
Jonas
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: flex_schedule_agreement.docx (draft; stub)

From: Occupational Health <occupationalhealth@provider.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RTW recommendations for Mina Haddad

Hi Jonas/Mina —

Thanks for sending Mina’s post-op summary. Per the attached OT note, we recommend the following restrictions initially: seated work, no >30 minutes continuous typing without a 5–10 minute break, and graded increase of duty over 4 weeks (60% → 80% → 100% as tolerated).

We advise weekly check-ins with occupational therapy and a formal assessment at week 4 to clear for full-time duties. Please flag any change in symptoms.

Best regards,
Dr. Laura Chen
Occupational Medicine
Provider Health Services

Attachment: OT_note_Mina_Haddad.pdf (clinical note; stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan: Mina RTW weeks 1–6 (draft)

Folks —

Draft mutual action plan (please review; I’ll publish a final Confluence page after any edits):
1) Schedule
   - Weeks 1–2 (60%): Mon/Wed/Thu 10:00–15:00 (core overlap), Tue/Fri remote light duty 10:00–14:00.
   - Weeks 3–4 (80%): increase remote hours; core days extend to 10:00–17:00 on Mon/Wed.
   - Week 5–6: reassess after OT clearance for 100% return.

2) Coverage and responsibilities
   - On-call / pager: Dev Patel will assume primary pager response and rotate with squad for critical escalations (Dev to update runbook and escalation doc).
   - PR and release approvals: Monica will own approvals for the feature branch gates; Jonas will triage high-priority decision items.
   - Knowledge handoff: Mina to record quick walkthroughs of priority areas before start date; schedule 60-min handoff with Dev the week prior.

3) Check-ins & metrics
   - Weekly 30-min RTW sync (Mon 11:00 PST).
   - Bi-weekly 1:1 with manager for workload and recovery updates.

4) Formalities
   - Mina to sign flexible schedule agreement via DocuSign (link below). HR to process proration for pay/benefits.

Links: Confluence RTW draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/RTW-123
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/sign/abc123-flex-schedule

Please reply with any edits; I’ll send calendar invites and the final agreement once we have sign-off.

— Jonas

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Mutual action plan: Mina RTW weeks 1–6 (HR confirmations)

Thanks for the thorough plan, Jonas. A few HR notes: we will need the signed flex schedule agreement before the start date for our records and to update payroll for the proration. PTO accrual will be pro-rated per the Flexible Work policy; I’ve looped in benefits (pws-fmla@benefitsco.com) for confirmation.

I’ll send the DocuSign envelope today and create the recurring calendar invites for the weekly RTW sync and the 1:1s. Also – please ensure the runbook is updated and shared with Dev before 9 Nov.

— Monica
People Ops (Interim)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (RTW sync stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Mina RTW weeks 1–6 (final)

Hi all —

I signed the DocuSign envelope and confirmed with OT that the start date of Mon 22 Nov works for the graded return. Thank you, Jonas and Dev, for taking the handoff work this month; Monica, thank you for processing the payroll/proration details.

I’ll post the recorded walkthroughs to the shared drive by Friday and will attend the first RTW sync on Mon 22 Nov.

Appreciate the support —
Mina
Senior Software Engineer
Redwood Inference
